caption: James McNeill Whistler, Nocturne, Blue and Silver: Battersea Reach (c. 1872-1878)
alt: A nearly abstract painting in dim blue-green and grey: still water under a misty night sky, a few faint orange lights on the far bank, and a barely visible small boat near the bottom.
bibliography: Whistler, James McNeill. Nocturne, Blue and Silver: Battersea Reach. c. 1872–1878, Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum, Boston.
title: Nocturne, Blue and Silver: Battersea Reach
